title: Rosemary Beach: Knoepp Cottage in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description:
Rosemary Beach: Knoepp Cottage in Rosemary Beach. Just a one-minute stroll from the beach, this spacious three bedroom home features expansive porches and wonderful Gulf views!

The first floor Master Suite has a queen bed, cozy fireplace, and private master bath.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Just a one-minute stroll from the beach, this spacious three bedroom home features expansive porches and wonderful Gulf views!

The first floor Master Suite has a queen bed, cozy fireplace, and private master bath. A second queen bedroom and a third bunkroom share a full hall bath. Room for an extra can be arranged in a twin day bed under the stairs.

The second floor offers a large living with a queen sofa sleeper, dining, and kitchen area and a half bath. Step onto the balcony to enjoy the refreshing beach air and vistas of the Gulf’s sparkling waters.

Garage parking available for one vehicle.

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY
